purpose: UI visual brainstorming; not implemented in Unity

variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Redesign the attached NEON IMPACT game UI as a premium art-direction exploration board, not a working game screenshot.
Input image 1 is the EXISTING GAME AND CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE: preserve the recognizable elongated cosmic humanoid, circular halo, four-point star motif and 2D neon arena identity, but redesign the UI layout, surfaces and typography fully.
Produce ONE high-resolution landscape board with FOUR equally large clean 16:10 game-screen mockups in a 2 by 2 grid, narrow gutters and a slim style-title header. No device frames, perspective, photography, fake code, or tiny annotations. Each screen must feel like an actual polished desktop game UI.
Top-left MAIN LOBBY: a strong NEON IMPACT wordmark, small player identity Guest and currency, two distinct mode entries "無際戰場" and "頂尖對決"; a large primary "開始遊戲" action with Infinity mode selected; secondary "收藏", settings and region ASIA. Original cosmic character is a calm composition on the right; left area is readable and spacious. No team play, season pass, or nonexistent social features.
Top-right COLLECTION: title "收藏", clear category tabs "頭部" "身體" "背部", restrained skill icon cards, owned/locked states, one selected skill expanded with icon, short stat rows and a simple action. Retain original 95-skill concept without inventing rarity/gacha tiers.
Bottom-left BATTLE HUD: actual top-down 2D neon arena with SMALL flat humanoid tokens and little star pickups, not a third-person shooter. Very unobtrusive UI, health and level at lower left, three automatic skill slots labeled "頭部" "身體" "背部" at bottom center, a compact 5-row leaderboard top right and two-line kill feed top left. Keep play area mostly empty and high contrast. No WASD prompts, gun crosshairs, minimap, or numbered hotkeys implying manual skill casts.
Bottom-right RESULTS: beautiful "挑戰勝利" composition with four-point star emblem, clear kills, survival time and stars earned, primary "返回大廳". Balanced typography with sufficient negative space and two small secondary stats.
All Chinese labels must be accurate Traditional Chinese, use short readable text, no long fabricated paragraphs. Crisp alignment, coherent spacing, controlled contrast, fully contained controls with safe margins. Tone, corner shapes, typography, icon language and effects must be consistent across all four screens. This is a visual proposal, don't add technical labels like Unity/Fusion/API.
STYLE A — "A / OBSIDIAN CIRCUIT": restrained modern competitive game interface, graphite-black #0A1017 panels, faint deep blue atmospheric field, small precise mint #79F2C0 accents and warm off-white text. Coral reserved for damage and loss. Condensed sturdy uppercase English wordmark, crisp Traditional Chinese sans-serif. Rectangular panels with a tiny clipped corner and thin edge highlight, mostly opaque surfaces, generous spacing, ONE bright mint action, other actions subdued. Elegant microtechnical dividers, minimal bloom only on the character and active selection. Preserve the original mint-neon DNA while making it calm, confident and meticulous. No excessive glowing borders, hexagon wallpaper, purple gradients or glass blur. Battle world can retain original navy/mint art. Board outer background near-black with title "A / OBSIDIAN CIRCUIT".
